messages:
tess: Heads-up 10pm booking for Madrid tomorrow. Corporate card declined and I had to use my personal card. It's a 1-night trip (in/out next day). Also paid a group dinner where two folks Venmo'd me back. Quick Qs: 1) do I get per diem for a 1-night trip? 2) will FX/bank fees be reimbursed? 3) can I submit one taxi receipt and split it?
people-ops: Short answers: 1) Yes 

per diem applies for overnight trips; 1-night qualifies. If you want per diem, opt in on the expense and do NOT submit meal receipts for the same calendar day. 2) We reimburse the full charge shown on your card statement (that includes FX). If the FX/foreign transaction fee is a separate bank line, include it and we'll reimburse when corporate card was unusable. 3) For taxis you can submit one expense and include an attendee split table, but finance prefers individual submissions where feasible.
people-ops: Required steps for personal-card due to decline:
- file a card-incident ticket within 48h explaining the decline
- attach itemized hotel folio / e-receipt + card statement line showing charge
- add manager approval in expense comments
people-ops: Venmo / Cash App / P2P payments: include a screenshot of payment + a short attendee list and the payment settlement screenshot. For P2P transfers we require manager sign-off for any amount > $50.
leo: Follow-up: I paid a €18 taxi in cash and lost the paper receipt. What's the threshold for missing receipts?
people-ops: Missing receipts policy: under $25 local currency -> acceptable with bank txn screenshot and brief note. €18 qualifies. For amounts $25to $75 -> manager sign-off required in expense comments. Above $75 -> written explanation + manager approval + finance review. Repeated missing receipts may delay reimbursements.
finance-bot: :clipboard: Quick checklist to attach in Expensify/portal:
- itemized merchant receipt (pdf or photo)
- card statement line showing the charge and FX conversion (if applicable)
- card-incident ID or travel preapproval (retro ones allowed but add reason)
- attendee split table for shared expenses (name -> amount)
- screenshots for P2P payments
finance-bot: NOTE: If your card statement doesn't surface an FX rate, include the bank posting with amount in both currencies or a third-party rate (xe.com) with the transaction date and add a note.
travel-bot: :alarm_clock: Reminder: retro preapprovals should be submitted ASAP and no later than 72h after departure to avoid holds. Link: https://redwood.example/travel-policy
tess: Thanks 
Uploading receipts now and filing the card incident. Will opt into per diem for simplicity. Appreciate the quick help!
